title.zh: 将连接 Ormoc 市与莱特省 Merida 市镇的公路命名为参议员 Rafael C. Martinez 纪念公路的法案
title.en: An Act Naming the Highway Connecting Ormoc City to the Municipality of Merida, Province of Leyte, as the Senator Rafael C. Martinez Memorial Highway
title.orig: An Act Naming the Highway Connecting Ormoc City to the Municipality of Merida, Province of Leyte, as the Senator Rafael C. Martinez Memorial Highway

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1991/ra_6979_1991.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The highway connecting Ormoc City to the Municipality of Merida, Province of Leyte, is hereby named as the Senator Rafael C. Martinez Memorial Highway.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
